safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No mention in Generated Facts of denial of neck stiffness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute, new or more severe headache, documenting absence of neck stiffness helps contextualize meningitis/subarachnoid hemorrhage risk and supports safer triage/management decisions. Omission may lead to unnecessary escalation or, less commonly, missed appreciation that a key red-flag screen was negative when care is handed over.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No mention in Generated Facts of denial of fever.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Fever is a key red-flag associated with infectious or inflammatory causes of headache; documenting its absence supports lower-risk assessment. Omitting this negative finding can impair subsequent clinician risk stratification and may prompt avoidable investigations or uncertainty in follow-up planning.
